purpose: Classify one sealed crew-arm native trace in which a shared A/B configured mission launched and succeeded while no mission crew remained booked. This does not accept the failed v1.0.2 positive pair.

source_lineage.accepted_parent_and_dependency_seals: The immutable v1.0.2 contract and 77-pin prelaunch manifest must be rehashed in full. They bind the accepted A16, A11, C05, A03 and C01 source lineage, 23 distinct local/published-Git source identities and 48 accepted raw seals. Do not substitute a new parent or rerun it.
source_lineage.frozen_pair_source: The v1.0.2 crew input is the sole source arm. Its 33-table object, 24 row-containing authored tables, A16-parent full-table delta and crew-vs-radio two-cell pair diff remain byte-pinned. The radio source is comparison context only; no radio native result exists.

read_only_acceptance.source_and_native_seals: Rehash every explicit pin above; parse the 77-pin original manifest and verify every source SHA/size and before/after closure map; verify all 13 closure raw SHA/size seals and all failure-seal entries. Require exact approved SSH0/mutex/GUI identity and six ordered steps, with four native children in session0/exit0, roundtrip PASS and final behavior check failed. Require zero errors, four contextual warnings (#108 Control rec1; #2053 Item rec1/2/3), zero notes. The unstarted radio run directory must remain absent.
read_only_acceptance.source_topology: Compare the frozen v1.0.2 crew input with accepted A16 parent and its exact-diff: two deployed base aircraft, same MTID mission requiring one CBSID A and one B, A and B each MissionResource MISSION-CREW QTY1, crew capacity2/radio0, one opening local A/B stock item each; no new input or acceptance reinterpretation.
read_only_acceptance.physical_trace: Require h7 two distinct base-aircraft allocations 0/1 and two one-unit crew availability/booking records, each paired with same-hour assignment release; A ID0 and B ID2 each demanded and taken from the corresponding opening physical stock; two fit tasks on base0/base1 complete h7.33333, configured A0/B1 preparation and h8 launch, h10 success/completion. Verify no return/backorder and terminal A/B stock0, base LRU stock1. Both demand lines have the same position suffix0; do not equate it with aircraft IDs or assert an unlogged item-to-aircraft serial link.
read_only_acceptance.zero_held_crew: Require both h8 launch and mission task lines to display MISSION-CREW 0 for configured A0 and B1; two h10 operation releases have QTY0. Every one of 72 ResourceResults bins must have NRMA=NRMO=NRUM=NRW=0 and NR/NRA/NRN=2; ResourceResultsTotal has NRMA=NRMO=NRUM=NRW=0 and NR=2. This is the bounded counterexample to the frozen crew1 positive gate, not evidence that no transient h7 booking occurred.
read_only_acceptance.full_report: Parse the six native report tables including trailing-comma syntax without modifying raw bytes. Independently reconcile every identity, null, numeric and time-integral cell: ProblemDescription 1, ResultSummary 11, SystemResults 72x40=2880, StockTotalResults 72x16=1152, ResourceResults 72x16=1152, ResourceResultsTotal 14: total 5210. Use the source plus physical event ledger for h7 reconfiguration, h8–10 flight, h10 aircraft return, stock demand/takes, resource zero occupancy and terminal h36; do not accept a report-hash comparison or the failed author validator alone.
read_only_acceptance.summary_and_terminal: ResultSummary NREP1, report window [0,36], MTMF/MSTF/MSUF/STMF all1. Two aircraft ready again at h10 and through h36; no second mission, fault, repair, stock return or backorder. Distinguish h35.5–36 last report bin from the h36 terminal boundary.
read_only_acceptance.negative_control: Preserve v1.0.2 original NO_GO and its failed author-validation bytes. Explicitly reject any claim that the positive pair passed, any radio-arm outcome, any persistent crew reservation, item serial continuity across a return, or general CBSID resource-inheritance behavior.

limitations: One seed, one two-aircraft shared CBSID mission, one installed 2017 SIMLOX CLI run and one source configuration; no matched negative radio-arm run.
The original positive paired experiment failed. This retrospective source-bound case records a counterexample to that positive hypothesis only.
The two h7 bookings were transient and released when reconfiguration began. Native log and report show zero held crew during operation; no hidden runtime cause is inferred.
Demand position suffix is not a physical aircraft ID in this trace. Item type/count, observed IDs and separate fit/launch edges are checkable; unlogged serial-to-aircraft attachment is not.
No GUI rendering, other seed, alternate mission duration, broader resource precedence, or general engine law is verified.
